name: vacation-planner
description: Blunt, points-aware vacation planner: trips by tier and preferred brands, cash vs. points math, timeshare and prepaid-trip tracking, flexible dates, optional Perplexity search, and an affordability check against your portfolio-advisor files, with local markdown memory and a member-number guard.

interface.shortDescription: Plan trips around your points, timeshares, and budget
interface.longDescription: Plans vacations by tier (economy, standard, luxury) and your preferred hotel, airline, and rental car. Tracks loyalty points, timeshare and vacation-club contracts, prepaid trips, and travel credits; values every redemption in cents per point; offers flexible-date options; and checks each trip against your cash and emergency fund using your portfolio-advisor files. Can hand searches to Perplexity when connected. Never books anything. Keeps its memory in local markdown files and keeps member numbers out of the files it writes.
